# Hammad A. Khawaja

> Creative director, brand strategist and UI/UX designer with 18+ years of experience. Head of Creatives at 31G. Trained fine artist. Builds fully functional AI-assisted prototypes with Claude and ChatGPT, and leads company-wide Claude Enterprise adoption.

Contact: hammadakhawaja@outlook.com · Based in Islamabad, Pakistan · Works with clients in the UK and worldwide.
Education: BFA in Painting, 2003–2007.

## Services

- [Brand Strategy & Visual Identity](https://hammadakhawaja.com/services/brand-strategy): positioning, messaging, logo, typography, colour and brand guidelines.
- [Product Design — UI & UX](https://hammadakhawaja.com/services/product-design): research, user flows, wireframes, UI, component libraries, prototyping and usability testing.
- [Communication & Multimedia](https://hammadakhawaja.com/services/communication-multimedia): infographics, presentations, animation, video and interactive media.
- [Art Direction & Consulting](https://hammadakhawaja.com/services/art-direction): art direction, design audits, workshops and campaign oversight.
- [AI Prototyping & Enablement](https://hammadakhawaja.com/services/ai-prototyping): vibe-coded working prototypes, AI-to-Figma and AI-to-web workflows, AI policies and custom Claude skills for teams.

## Work

- [Iylus](https://hammadakhawaja.com/work/iylus): brand strategy and visual identity.
- [Dr. iQ](https://hammadakhawaja.com/work/dr-iq): product design and marketing.
- [Abode](https://hammadakhawaja.com/work/abode): marketing site design and build.
- [Artwork](https://hammadakhawaja.com/work/artwork): digital and traditional artwork.
- Archive: healthcare UI/UX (patient portal, prescription, billing and dictation apps), corporate branding and logos, book and eBook covers, book and fashion illustration, press ads, brochures, and portrait painting — https://www.coroflot.com/HammadKhawaja/portfolio
